title: review: Backlog B1: jev_route cache_max_entries = 0 disables caching instead of keeping every entry (slice [-0:] bug), and scorecard CLI rejects --economics together with --efficiency with a clear error while the --by help and error text name both modes (reviews T-0486 low and T-0468 low)
spec:
Phase I backlog on goal/T-0445 (head 4149f67). Work only in your own worktree and commit only on your own branch.
1. orchestrator/jev_route.py _cache_write (around line 74): when [jev.routing].cache_max_entries is 0, caching is disabled: nothing is written and lookups always miss; when it is positive, keep the newest max_entries entries (the current sorted(...)[-max_entries:] is a no-op for 0 because [-0:] is the whole list). Negative values are treated as 0. Test tests/test_jev_route.py::test_cache_max_entries_zero_disables_caching (two classify calls for the same task make two jev.ask calls and route_cache.json stays absent or empty).
2. orchestrator/cli.py scorecard flags (around lines 163-169): passing both --economics and --efficiency exits with code 2 and the message "choose one of --economics, --efficiency, --routing"; the same for any two of the three. The error for --by band|class|role without a mode names both modes that support it ("--by band|class|role requires --efficiency or --economics"). Test tests/test_cli.py::test_cli_scorecard_rejects_two_modes_and_names_by_modes.
Keep every existing test green; full .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exit 0; commit with the task id including both named tests; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree; the commit is on this task's own branch
